```rust
fn metadata_matches(&self, key: &Key, filters: &[(String, String)]) -> bool {

        Ok(v) => v,
        _ => return false,                     // invalid YAML → excluded
    };
    filters.iter().all(|(k, v)| {              // AND across all --meta flags

            .and_then(|node| match node {
                serde_yaml::Value::String(s)   => Some(s.as_str() == v.as_str()),
                serde_yaml::Value::Bool(b)     => Some(b.to_string() == *v),
                serde_yaml::Value::Number(n)   => Some(n.to_string() == *v),
                serde_yaml::Value::Sequence(items) => Some(
                    items.iter().any(|i| i.as_str().map(|s| s == v.as_str()).unwrap_or(false))
                ),                              // OR within one sequence value
                _ => Some(false),               // Mapping / Null → never matches
            })
            .unwrap_or(false)                   // missing key → excluded
    })
}
```

Key semantics:
- **AND across `--meta` flags** (`filters.iter().all(...)`); every `KEY=VALUE` must match.
- **OR within a YAML sequence** (`items.iter().any(...)`); listing `tags: [a, b, c]` matches `--meta tags=b`.

- **Case-sensitive string equality**, with bool/number stringified via `to_string()` (so `--meta published=true` and `--meta count=3` work).
- Mappings and Null match nothing. Missing keys, missing frontmatter, and unparsable YAML all evaluate to false.
